about: A's period policy. recent_anchor_rule data_latest counts recent N units back from the catalog's latest period of the selected table and frequency. anchor_rule as_of_calendar remains for calendar-relative expressions and explicit open ends; explicit closed dates stay fixed. A single closed explicit request with a verified continuous available prefix and only a future missing tail is handed to B unchanged, with separate available and missing range notices. Past shortfall, unavailable whole requests and edition compatibility guards remain. condition_rule ask_condition asks when the user has not supplied a period or frequency and never applies a default. default_recent_years remains for historical resolver compatibility only. B's final query interpretation and updated metadata are a separate connection contract.
